mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte imbalances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may potentiate zolpidem's CNS depression and impair its metabolism in renally compromised patients.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; assess for excessive sedation and CNS depression; consider alternative antifungal if possible or dose adjustment of zolpidem based on renal status.
